7	## uip maestro flow init
8	
9	Scaffold a new Flow project directory. Outside a solution, `flow init` auto-scaffolds `<ProjectName>Solution/` and nests the project in it. **Prefer creating the solution first** so its name matches the project name (see the [Author greenfield journey — Step 2](../author/references/greenfield.md)).
10	
11	```bash
12	# 1. Create solution first (for naming control)
13	uip solution init "<SolutionName>" --output json
14	
15	# 2. Init the flow project inside the solution folder.
16	#    Inside a solution directory, `flow init` auto-registers the project with
17	#    the parent `.uipx`. Outside any solution, it auto-scaffolds
18	#    `<ProjectName>Solution/<ProjectName>Solution.uipx`, nests the project in it,
19	#    and adds `Data.AutoCreatedSolution` to the response. Either way confirm via
20	#    `Data.SolutionRegistration.Status` (`Registered` or `AlreadyRegistered`).
21	#    `--skip-solution-registration` opts out of both (Status `OptedOut`).
22	cd <directory>/<SolutionName> && uip maestro flow init <ProjectName> --output json
23	
24	# 3. (Fallback only) Wire the project manually if registration was
25	#    `Skipped` / `Failed` (ambiguous discovery or `.uipx` write error), or the
26	#    rare `NotInSolution`. (`OptedOut` means `--skip-solution-registration` was
27	#    passed and the skip was intentional.)
28	uip solution project add \
29	  <directory>/<SolutionName>/<ProjectName> \
30	  <directory>/<SolutionName>/<SolutionName>.uipx
31	```
32	
33	Creates `<ProjectName>/` with `project.uiproj`, `<ProjectName>.flow`, `bindings_v2.json`, `entry-points.json`, `operate.json`, and `package-descriptor.json` inside the solution directory.
34	
35	## uip maestro flow validate
36	
37	Validate a `.flow` file locally — no auth, no network.
38	
39	```bash
40	uip maestro flow validate <path/to/file.flow>
41	uip maestro flow validate <path/to/file.flow> --output json
42	uip maestro flow validate <path/to/file.flow> --verbose --output json
43	
44	# With governance policy checks (requires login)
45	uip maestro flow validate <path/to/file.flow> --governance --output json
46	```
47	
48	Checks:
49	
50	- JSON parses correctly
51	- All required fields present (including `targetPort` on edges)
52	- Every node `type:typeVersion` has a matching entry in `definitions`
53	- Edge `sourceNodeId`/`targetNodeId` reference existing node `id`s
54	- Node `id`s are unique; edge `id`s are unique
55	
56	Exit code 0 = valid, 1 = invalid.
57	
58	### `--governance` flag
59	
60	Validates agent nodes against organization governance policies fetched from the platform. Requires `uip login`. When governance data cannot be fetched (no login, platform unreachable), the command exits with a failure. Omit `--governance` to run local-only schema validation without auth.
61	
62	## uip maestro flow format
63	
64	Auto-layout nodes in the `.flow` file. Run after validation passes and before publishing or debugging — without format, hand-written or stale `layout` data can render as misshapen rectangles in Studio Web.
65	
66	```bash
67	uip maestro flow format <path/to/file.flow>
68	uip maestro flow format <path/to/file.flow> --output json
69	```
70	
71	Format:
72	- Arranges nodes horizontally (left-to-right) and anchors to the leftmost node's original position so the user's general layout intent is preserved
73	- Sets each node's `size` to match its canvas shape — inline agents (`shape: rectangle`) → `{ "width": 288, "height": 96 }`, containers (loops/groups) → `{ "width": 560, "height": 320 }`, everything else (incl. referenced `uipath.core.agent.<guid>`) → `{ "width": 96, "height": 96 }`; sticky-note custom sizes are preserved
74	- Recurses into subflows and rewrites `subflows[<id>].layout` for each
75	- Backfills missing `position`/`size` entries
76	- Does not modify node logic, edges, definitions, or variables — only layout coordinates
77	
78	JSON output (`--output json`) reports counts in `Data`: `NodesTotal`, `EdgesTotal`, `NodesRepositioned`, `NodesResized`, `SubflowsTidied`.
